name: Shadowstalker Scalp
summary: A Shadowstalker Scalp is a reagent taken from a Hatefury shadowstalker in Desolace. Maurin Bonesplitter needs it to break wards against scrying for a spell aimed at finding a demon lord.

sections.title: A Satyr's Scalp
sections.body: Among the ancient ruins near Sargeron in northeastern Desolace, Hatefury shadowstalkers guard the scalp Maurin Bonesplitter seeks. He believes it can break a demon lord's wards against scrying. Bring him the right scalp; he warns that the wrong reagent could bring death to those who attempt the spell.

faq.q: What is a Shadowstalker Scalp for?
faq.answer: Maurin Bonesplitter needs the scalp to break a demon lord's wards against scrying.

faq.q: Where do I find a Shadowstalker Scalp?
faq.answer: Hatefury shadowstalkers near the ancient ruins of Sargeron in northeastern Desolace have the scalp Maurin seeks.
Maurin Bonesplitter is seeking reagents for a spell to find a demon lord.

faq.q: Why does Maurin need this particular scalp?
faq.answer: Maurin says the scalp must come from a Hatefury shadowstalker so he can break the demon lord's wards against scrying.

angles.text: Maurin says you act in the Warchief's name as you gather reagents for his search.
